svg.title: One request through the three tiers
svg.desc: Your request reaches Front Door, which redirects HTTP to HTTPS and applies waflab's custom rules, blocking /admin and more than 100 requests a minute from one address. Front Door sends it over HTTPS with the X-Azure-FDID header to ca-web, which refuses anything without that header with 403. ca-web calls the internal ca-app, which reaches the SQL server's private endpoint on TCP 1433; the server's public access is off.
